attractions.name_base: Xunjin Street CityWalk Route (Kunming's Niche Literary Corridor)
attractions.location_base: Xunjin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming (梧桐林荫道, near Cuihu Lake north side)
attractions.location_local: 昆明市五华区巡津街（翠湖北侧梧桐林荫道）
attractions.notes_base: The niche local pick over Wenlin Street. 小红书 verified: '比翠湖更chill！昆明巡津街citywalk' (1044 likes), '不是上海武康路！昆明这街才是松弛感天花板' (1407 likes), '昆明老街到巡津街，本地人的Citywalk路线' (943 likes), '昆明·巡津街！我找到了陶渊明笔下的。。。' (377 likes). Quote: '巡津街比文林街更值得CityWalk' (281 likes). A tree-lined boulevard with parasol trees creating a tunnel canopy, much quieter than tourist-heavy Wenlin Street and Wenhua Lane. Locals call it 'Kunming's Wu Kang Road' — evokes the same relaxed, time-suspended atmosphere. Independent coffee shops, vintage bookstores, small galleries. Perfect for INFJ: no crowds, sensory calm, authentic neighborhood life. Combined route suggestion: 翠湖公园 (Cuihu Park, free, 06:30-21:30) → walk north exit → 巡津街 → explore 1-2 hours → optional: loop back through 文林街 for comparison. Total 2.5 hours, all flat walking. Verified via 小红书 multiple notes with high engagement.
attractions.notes_local: 本地人首选，比文林街更值得CityWalk。小红书验证：「比翠湖更chill！昆明巡津街citywalk」(1044点赞)，「不是上海武康路！昆明这街才是松弛感天花板」(1407点赞)，「昆明老街到巡津街，本地人的Citywalk路线」(943点赞)，「昆明·巡津街！我找到了陶渊明笔下的。。。」(377点赞)。原话引用：「巡津街比文林街更值得CityWalk」(281点赞)。梧桐树形成天然穹顶，比文化巷/文林街游客少很多，昆明本地人叫它「昆明版武康路」——同款松弛感，没有商业噪音。有独立咖啡馆、旧书店、小画廊。INFJ体质友好：无人群、感官平静、真实街区烟火气。建议路线：翠湖公园（免费，06:30-21:30）→北门出→巡津街漫步1-2小时→可选绕回文林街对比感受。全程2.5小时，平坦好走。

attractions.name_base: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Scenic Area
attractions.name_local: 玉龙雪山国家级风景名胜区
attractions.location_base: Tourism Ring Road, Yulong Naxi Autonomous County, Lijiang City
attractions.location_local: 云南省丽江市玉龙纳西族自治县旅游环线
attractions.notes_base: CRITICAL: Book tickets online in advance — cable car tickets sell out fast especially in summer. Scenic area entrance: 105 CNY. Glacier Park cable car extra 160 CNY. Altitude 3,000-4,500m — bring warm layers even in June, bring altitude sickness medication (高反药). Depart by 07:00 to catch 08:00 opening. Take the 101 special bus from Zhongyi Market (忠义市场). Recommended: Glacier Park (4680m viewpoint) OR Yunshu Ping meadow (云杉坪) — choose one, don't try to rush both. In June, snowpack may be thin at Glacier Park — check recent RedNote posts before going. INFJ tip: Glacier Park is more dramatic; Yunshu Ping (云杉坪) is more peaceful and forested — perfect for the quieter INFJ mood. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 重要：提前网上购票，缆车票夏季极易售罄。景区门票105元，冰川公园索道另付160元。海拔3000-4500米，6月仍需带厚外套和高反药（红景天提前3天服用）。早上07:00前出发，从忠义市场乘101路专线。推荐冰川公园（4680米网红打卡点）或云杉坪草甸之一——不要贪多赶两个。6月冰川雪量可能偏少，出发前在小红书查看最新打卡照。INFJ提示：冰川公园更震撼，云杉坪更安静幽深适合发呆，看当天心情选择。小红书验证。

attractions.name_base: Blue Moon Valley (Jade Dragon Snow Mountain)
attractions.location_base: Inside Yulong Snow Mountain Scenic Area, Lijiang City
attractions.location_local: 云南省丽江市玉龙雪山国家级风景名胜区内
attractions.notes_base: Included with scenic area entrance ticket (105 CNY). Series of vivid turquoise lakes fed by Jade Dragon Snow Mountain snowmelt. 小红书 users highlight Jade Liquid Lake (玉液湖) as the most photogenic spot — water glows blue-green, snow mountain reflected on the surface. Take the sightseeing electric cart within the valley (recommended — it's a long walk otherwise). Best visited in afternoon after morning at Glacier Park or Yunshu Ping. Allow 2-3 hours. INFJ tip: arrive after 14:00 when morning crowds thin; the turquoise water is mesmerizing and calming — ideal for quiet couple photography. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 包含在玉龙雪山景区门票内（105元）。雪山融水形成的翡翠色湖泊群，水质清澈发蓝绿光。小红书用户强推玉液湖，随手拍都是壁纸级，雪山倒影完美。建议乘坐景区内的观光电瓶车游览（步行时间太长）。上午玩冰川公园/云杉坪后，下午游蓝月谷，留2-3小时。INFJ提示：14:00后上午人流散去，湖水蓝绿颜色极为治愈，是情侣发呆拍照的好地方。

attractions.location_base: Shuhe Town, Lijiang City, Yunnan Province
attractions.notes_base: Morning in Shuhe before afternoon drive to Dali. REST DAY — take it slow. Much quieter and less touristy than Lijiang Old Town. Known for artsy cafes with beautiful courtyard gardens. 小红书 verified recommendation: look for 山竹咖啡 (Shanzhu Coffee) with bamboo forest courtyard and lounge sofas (Bohemian + new Chinese style, very photogenic), and 岛与咖啡 (Dao Yu Coffee) with large green lawn for afternoon sun-bathing. Stroll along the ancient canals and Shuhe Square. Half-day leisurely wander is perfect. INFJ tip: arrive after 10:00 when vendors are setting up but tourist buses haven't arrived; leave before 15:00. The cobblestone lanes and water channels have an intimate scale that rewards slow exploration. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 下午开车去大理前的上午束河游览。休息日，慢慢逛。比丽江古城安静，文艺咖啡馆遍布。小红书推荐：山竹咖啡（波西米亚竹林院子，多处躺椅沙发，超出片），岛与咖啡（大草坪，午后晒太阳极好）。沿古镇水渠漫步，在四方听音广场坐坐。半天慢悠悠逛就好。INFJ提示：10:00后到，游客大巴15:00前来，中午前最舒适；石板小巷和水渠尺度亲人，适合慢慢探索发现。

attractions.location_base: Baisha Town, Yulong Naxi Autonomous County, Lijiang
attractions.location_local: 云南省丽江市玉龙纳西族自治县白沙镇
attractions.notes_base: Optional afternoon add-on if energy allows. Smaller and more authentic than Shuhe — a traditional Naxi village with almost no tourist crowds. 小红书 recommended highlights: 云中白沙书局 (Yun Zhong Baisha Library) — a stunning design-forward library and cafe with rooftop views of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain; 石榴院子咖啡酒馆 (Pomegranate Courtyard Cafe) with 3-floor rooftop terrace, unique eclectic decor. About 5km north of Shuhe — take a taxi. INFJ tip: this is the most authentic, least commercial Naxi village experience in the Lijiang area. The 云中白沙书局 is a genuine sanctuary — books, architecture, mountain views — INFJ heaven. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 如有体力，下午可顺道去。比束河更小、更原汁原味，几乎没有商业游客。小红书必去：云中白沙书局（极具设计感的图书馆咖啡馆，屋顶可看雪山），石榴院子咖啡酒馆（三层屋顶观景台，超出片）。从束河打车约5公里北行。INFJ提示：这是丽江周边最原汁原味、最无商业气息的纳西族村落体验。云中白沙书局是真正的庇护所——书、建筑、山景——INFJ理想境地。

attractions.location_base: Huguo Road 172, Dali City, Yunnan Province
attractions.location_local: 云南省大理白族自治州大理市护国路172号
attractions.notes_base: Arrive Dali in the afternoon after 3h drive from Lijiang/Shuhe. After the 3-hour self-drive from Lijiang, do a gentle evening stroll of Dali Old Town. The city is dramatically set between Cangshan Mountain (苍山) and Erhai Lake (洱海). Explore Renmin Road (人民路) — the main street with artsy cafes and independent bookshops. The old town has a distinct Bai minority architecture style: white walls, grey tiles, painted eaves. Much more relaxed than Lijiang. INFJ tip: evening atmosphere after 19:00 is peaceful and romantic — fewer day-trippers, warm lantern light, the mountain silhouette darkening behind the rooftops. Don't over-plan this evening — just wander. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 从丽江/束河开车约3小时下午抵达大理后漫步。从丽江自驾约3小时抵达后，傍晚轻松游览大理古城。古城位于苍山和洱海之间，风光独特。逛人民路，有许多文艺咖啡馆和独立书店。大理古城的白族建筑（白墙灰瓦、彩绘飞檐）与丽江风格截然不同。INFJ提示：19:00后氛围最好，日游客减少，灯笼暖光，身后苍山剪影，极为浪漫。这个傍晚不要过度规划，随意漫游即可。小红书验证。

attractions.name_base: Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor (West Shore Cycling Route)
attractions.name_local: 洱海生态廊道（海西骑行路线）
attractions.location_base: West Shore of Erhai Lake, Dali City, Yunnan Province
attractions.location_local: 云南省大理市洱海西岸环海西路
attractions.notes_base: The west shore ecological corridor is the most scenic cycling route around Erhai Lake — about 50km of paved lakeside path with Cangshan Mountain on one side and the lake on the other. Rent bikes or e-bikes near the corridor entry. Key stops verified via 小红书: 龙龛码头 (Longkan Dock) for sunrise and red pine trees, 磻溪S湾 (Panxi S-bend) for the iconic white bench and lake photo (morning light only — afternoon backlit), 廊桥 (Langqiao Bridge) for the arch-framed lake photo. Start early (08:00) for best light and fewer crowds. West shore is car-free — pure cycling and walking. Rent e-bikes near Caicun (才村) or Dali Ancient Town. INFJ tip: the silence of the lakeside path with mountains on one side and water on the other is deeply restorative. Stop anywhere that calls to you. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 海西生态廊道是洱海最美的骑行路线，约50公里，左边苍山右边洱海。可在廊道入口附近租自行车或电动车。小红书重点打卡：龙龛码头（红杉+湖面倒影，日出最美），磻溪S湾（白色长椅+S弯+洱海，上午光线最好，下午逆光），廊桥（桥洞框架构图，小红书热门机位）。早上08:00出发，光线最好人最少。海西廊道禁止机动车，骑行/步行皆可。在才村或大理古城附近租电动车。INFJ提示：山湖之间的廊道静默感极强，非常治愈。随性停留，不必赶路线。

attractions.location_base: S314 Huanhai East Road, Shuanglang Town, Dali City
attractions.location_local: 云南省大理州双廊镇S314环海东路
attractions.notes_base: Located on the east shore of Erhai Lake — offers the best sunset views looking west across the lake to Cangshan Mountain. Boutique guesthouses perched right over the water create an incredibly romantic lakeside atmosphere. The pebble beaches here are great for sitting and watching the sunset. Note: east shore is ~30km drive from west shore — plan accordingly, take a taxi after morning west-shore cycling. Many artsy cafes and boutique hotels with lake-view terraces. INFJ tip: 双廊 is where artists and creatives choose to live in Dali — the atmosphere is quiet, personal, and genuinely artistic rather than performatively touristy. Find a cafe with a lake-view seat and stay until after sunset. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 位于洱海东岸，是观看苍山日落倒影的最佳视角。精品民宿直接建在水边，洱海就在窗外，氛围极为浪漫。湖边鹅卵石滩适合坐着看日落。注意：东西岸距离约30公里，建议上午骑完西岸廊道后打车过来。文艺咖啡馆和观景台众多。INFJ提示：双廊是大理艺术家和创作者的聚居地，氛围安静、私密，是真正的文艺气息而非表演给游客的。找一个湖景座位的咖啡馆，待到日落后再走。

attractions.location_base: Qingzhen Road 130, Xizhou Town, Dali City
attractions.location_local: 云南省大理市喜洲镇清真路130号
attractions.notes_base: Morning visit before driving to Kunming in the afternoon. Xizhou is a well-preserved Bai minority ancient town 18km north of Dali Old Town — less touristy and more authentic than the main old town. Famous for grand Bai-style courtyard mansions (白族大院). Highlights verified via 小红书: stroll the Four Directions Square (四方街) lined with traditional Bai architecture, explore 喜林苑 (Xilin Courtyard) — a beautifully restored heritage mansion that is one of Asia's top boutique hotels. The surrounding fields have seasonal crops. Explore the small lanes behind the main square for authentic Bai village life. Take a taxi or bus from Dali Old Town (~30 min). Allow 2-3 hours in the morning. INFJ tip: the scale of the Bai courtyard mansions — their ornate but restrained decoration, the deep quiet of the interior courtyards — is a strong INFJ experience of space and history. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 上午游览，下午开车去昆明。喜洲是大理以北18公里的白族古镇，比大理古城商业化程度低，保存完好的白族大院是核心看点。小红书验证亮点：四方街（传统白族建筑围合），喜林苑（修缮精美的历史院落，亚洲顶级精品酒店之一）。附近有麦田/稻田（季节限定）。从大理古城打车或坐公交约30分钟。上午游览2-3小时。INFJ提示：白族大院的尺度和装饰节制而华美，深院的静默感是INFJ对空间与历史的强烈体验。

attractions.name_base: Haize Ecological Park (Ershi Peninsula, Erhai Lake)
attractions.location_base: Haishe Peninsula, Erhai Lake West Shore, Dali City
attractions.location_local: 云南省大理市洱海西岸海舌半岛
attractions.notes_base: Morning visit before driving to Kunming in the afternoon. Optional afternoon visit after Xizhou. A scenic wetland peninsula jutting into Erhai Lake — three sides surrounded by water, with panoramic views of Cangshan Mountain across the lake. Very few tourists. 小红书 recommendation: advance online booking required. Allow 1 hour. Wild birds, calm water, secluded atmosphere — ideal INFJ escape spot. Located on the way back from Xizhou to Dali. INFJ tip: the peninsula's three-sided water view and the absence of crowds creates a rare quietude — perfect for afternoon reflection after the morning Xizhou visit. Verified via 小红书 user reviews.
attractions.notes_local: 上午游览，下午开车去昆明。喜洲游览后可顺路来的下午选项。海舌半岛三面环水，伸入洱海，游客极少，苍山倒影完美。小红书推荐需提前网上预约。游览1小时足够。鸟类众多，湖面宁静。INFJ提示：半岛三面临水、无游客的静默感极为珍贵，喜洲之后午后独处发呆的完美收尾。从喜洲回大理途中可顺路停留。
attractions.opening_hours: 需提前预约（建议提前1-2天网上预约）
